target_customer: Gen Z women, initially sorority members, who need outfits for frequent events
problem: Dressing for many events is costly; renting from other users' closets avoids buying and avoids a rental company's inventory.
product_category: Peer to peer clothing rental marketplace

founders.name: Capri Wheaton
education: UC Berkeley, dropped out (per The Pitch)
previous_startups: SaaS tool for clothing resellers (outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: Sources: YC page and The Pitch listing. Now invests at super{set}.

founders.name: Sam Yang
previous_startups: Bloom (2M users, $3.5M ARR per his YC bio)

competitors.name: Rent the Runway
competitors.what: Owns and cleans inventory for rental

technical_complexity.rationale: Standard marketplace app with listings, payments and shipping; hard parts are trust and logistics, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Marketplace with no inventory or cleaning control; supply and demand both had to be built from scratch and peers like By Rotation or Pickle could copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action recorded; Dressd went inactive.

market_need_then: Founders cited Depop and Poshmark teaching users to photograph and ship items; The Pitch listing cites a $5.87B rental market. Direct demand evidence not found.

branding.domain_note: Used dressd.com (per YC page link); acquisition terms not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Gen Z social tone; Instagram and TikTok accounts linked from the YC page.

branding.community_and_virality: Instagram (shop.dressd) and TikTok accounts and a Yahoo Finance piece are linked on the YC page; engagement not measured.

brand_strength.rationale: Dropped vowel spelling is confusable with Dressr and Dresst; no independent brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Dressd was a one founder P2P clothing rental marketplace aimed at sororities, accepted into YC Winter 2021. Databases show only a small convertible note from YC. No public post-mortem exists; the distribution_failed tag is an inference from a marketplace that never showed traction in any source found, so the cause is not public.
notes: dressd.com returned 503. Funding of $500K and note type from CB Insights only, unverified and undated. The Pitch listing tags it Funded without terms. Competitor Rent the Runway is named by the company on its YC page; no independently dated rival source found. Team size 1 per directory but YC page lists two founders. YC page founding year 2022 conflicts with batch.
